concerns.text: The plan cites 'FLUX Prompts' from LucasFang/FLUX-Reason-6M to compute semantic entropy, but the methodology requires measuring activation variance from DiT forward passes on MS-COCO images. The plan fails to establish a 1:1 mapping between the prompt dataset (FLUX) and the image dataset (MS-COCO). Without a shared ID or explicit pairing strategy, the correlation analysis (FR-001) cannot be computed as the entropy of a FLUX prompt cannot be paired with the activation variance of an unrelated MS-COCO image.

The plan proposes using 'facebook/bart-large-cnn' as a lightweight proxy for 'Semantic Entropy' via sampling-based estimation. BART-large-cnn is a summarization model, not a generative model capable of producing the multiple semantic samples required to estimate semantic entropy (which relies on clustering generated outputs). This tool choice is inappropriate for the defined metric, rendering the correlation hypothesis untestable as described.
